closed_founder_decisions.topic: rtpait.com & rtpait.com/admin/ Authentication Architecture (Passphrase Gate Deprecation -> Two-Tier OpenID Connect RBAC)
closed_founder_decisions.question: Should rtpait.com/admin/ continue using the legacy AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2 passphrase gate or migrate to OpenID Connect with Two-Tier RBAC?
closed_founder_decisions.decision: Deprecate and retire the legacy AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2 passphrase gate as the target architecture. Migrate rtpait.com to Two-Tier OpenID Connect (authorization_code + PKCE S256): Tier 1 (role: member) allows site-wide OpenID login for public/client profiles; Tier 2 (role: admin) locks /admin/* exclusively to Wally's Google OpenID credential (luke@rtpait.com). CRITICAL STAGE 3 GATE: federated_auth_enabled MUST remain false in live config files until Wally's explicit Stage 3 execution go-ahead.
closed_founder_decisions.rationale: Eliminates shared static passphrase management in favor of cryptographic Google OIDC identity verification (luke@rtpait.com) for the unified portfolio command center while enabling client profile persistence on public diagnostic tools.

closed_founder_decisions.topic: Founder Second-Brain Technical Implementation Architecture (3-Layer JSON-File Nodes vs. Graph Database)

closed_founder_decisions.decision: Start with a 3-Layer zero-graph-DB architecture: (1) Layer 1 JSON-File Nodes using existing structured ledgers (PRODUCT-STATE.md, RELEASE-CONTRIBUTION-LEDGER.json, WEB-TEAM-KAIZEN-LEDGER.json, PO-DAY0-OPEN-DECISIONS-BACKLOG.json, CRON-REGISTRY.json, token-usage-ledger.json); (2) Layer 2 Distilled Layer (/workspace/rtpait/analytics/SECOND-BRAIN-WORK-LOG.json curated by Chief of Staff); and (3) Layer 3 Query & Join Layer inside /workspace/rtpait/analytics/build_unified_admin_second_brain.py linking across domain, product_id, agent_id, commit_sha, stage, and date. No graph database.
closed_founder_decisions.rationale: Ships immediately with zero external database infrastructure overhead by leveraging the deterministic JSON/Markdown ledgers already maintained across the fleet.

closed_founder_decisions.topic: Universal OpenID Connect Across All Major IdPs + Absolute Ban on Manual Username/Password Auth + SMS 2FA Across All Surfaces
closed_founder_decisions.question: What identity providers, credential rules, and multi-factor authentication standards must govern rtpait.com /admin/, Paid Second-Brain API tenants, and all future customer-facing logins?
closed_founder_decisions.decision: Enforce 4 uniform rules across all access surfaces (/admin/ for luke@rtpait.com, Paid Second-Brain API tenant customers, and all future customer-facing logins across rtpait.com and portfolio products): (1) Universal OpenID Connect supporting all major identity providers (Google, Apple, Facebook, and enterprise IdPs like Microsoft Entra/GitHub/Okta); (2) Absolute Ban on Manual Username-and-Password Authentication (password_auth_prohibited = true — never build, store, or maintain password login or credential DBs anywhere); (3) OpenID Connect + SMS-Based Two-Factor Authentication (mfa_second_factor: 'SMS_2FA') as the required second factor; (4) Uniform coverage across admin, API tenant, and public login surfaces. Directed to Identity, Auth & Security Team (0a4f80df-97a0-411b-9349-727ca3d6ae4a) in /workspace/identity-security/CHARTER.md.
closed_founder_decisions.rationale: Eliminates password credential attack surfaces entirely while combining federated OIDC identity verification with SMS 2FA across founder, enterprise tenant, and consumer surfaces.
